reviewer: Codex trace/JSON review by python_environment subagent; not an independent human gold review
case_hash_method: SHA256 of the complete source case record serialized with json.dumps(ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True), matching qwen_live_support.digest

review_policy.observed_slots: Only accepted structured semantic state or workflow settings; quoted input, raw rejected candidates, capability prose and generic display defaults alone are not slot extraction evidence.
review_policy.intent: Judge understanding of the requested work separately from routing, using accepted interpretations and resulting questions/workflow.
review_policy.questions: One label per actual visible pending/draft clarification question, in turn order. Rejected raw suggestions are not questions asked.
review_policy.whole_request_success: Requires correct CLARIFY routing, all frozen required missing conditions appropriately asked, preservation of supplied facts, no unsupported assumptions or unrequested work. Does not imply external execution.
review_policy.holdout: C03/C06/C09 are evaluation only; observations are not repair instructions.

questions.evidence: The sole visible question jointly asks which report metrics to include and where the sales data comes from; it does not ask for the recipient.

The accepted requirements stage preserves schedule daily/09:00/Asia-Seoul and adds an other/clarify_data_source placeholder. development_findings: Validated request timezone now permits the written schedule to remain in the accepted ledger.
The requirement extractor still omits the recipient question and represents a design clarification as an other task.
